name: Platinum Vape 510 Live Resin | Super Sour Diesel
description:
Platinum Vape Super Sour Diesel is a Sativa strain. Super Sour Diesel cartridges 1g is THC dominant cannabis derived live resin. PV cartridges are compatible with 510 thread batteries.

Flavor Profile: Earthy, Sweet, Citrus
Effects: Uplifted, Happy, Euphoric, Creative, Energetic

Platinum Vape only uses the best ingredients nature has to offer in each cartridge, by extracting top-quality cannabis oil from a pesticide-free, high-potency harvest of the finest cannabis flowers.
